notes: National agreement covers the Oman Digital Triangle, described as three interconnected digital hubs and AI super-clusters with GW-scale capacities. Trade coverage of COMEX 2025 identifies Barka, Duqm and Sur as the three nodes; exact site, phase and MW per node not disclosed.
